principle: The player chooses Marion's ordinary intentions. MonIA schedules world events independently from destination buttons.

examples: Marion joins Marine and crowd movement brings her near Dominic.
Marion gets coffee while Dominic is nearby; either may notice the other.
Crowd jostles Marion while Dominic is drinking coffee.
A plausible pre-corrida logistical trajectory creates proximity near transport/activity areas.
Dominic notices Marion and remembers her before Marion knows who he is.

player_contract.choices: Describe only what Marion can intentionally decide now.
player_contract.forbidden_spoilers: Never label a choice with the hidden encounter or promised consequence.
player_contract.locations: A destination changes opportunity space, never guarantees an event.
player_contract.cinematics: Triggered by the world director only after hidden event resolution.

realism.rule: Research/context enriches possible situations, but generated events must remain compatible with canon and current save.
